source.title: Editor: Select trigger node label on the execute workflow button is hardcoded English

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

When a workflow has more than one trigger, the **Execute workflow** button on the canvas gets a small arrow next to it. You click the arrow to choose which trigger to run from. The arrow button has the label "Select trigger node", which screen readers read out. That label is written in English straight into the code, so it does not get translated.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/3895cb31de5731c8425e56e56ff6f1dad1e2aa50/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/workflows/canvas/components/elements/buttons/CanvasRunWorkflowButton.vue#L218

The rest of this button already uses i18n keys under `nodeView.runButtonText.*`.

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Open a workflow with two or more trigger nodes.
3. Inspect the arrow button next to **Execute workflow**, or move to it with a screen reader on.
4. The label is still "Select trigger node" in English.

### Expected behavior

The button label is in the selected language, like the rest of the button.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.47.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.47.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a fix ready and will open a PR.
